WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS country,
        AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / NULLIF(v.points_max, 0)) AS average_share
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country, '')
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_share) AS mean_country_share
    FROM country_averages
)
SELECT
    c.country,
    c.average_share,
    c.average_share / NULLIF(o.mean_country_share, 0) AS relative_ratio
FROM country_averages AS c
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o;
